prerequisite: V30 independent audit passes its frozen promotion gates
initialization: Each fold starts from V30 external-only adapter and untouched Qwen2.5-1.5B; no host-adapted checkpoint reused
training: Exact V30 host-stage settings, two epochs, new optimizer, same seed and epoch indexing; no pooling or neural hyperparameter search
score: Same clipped evidence and fixed sparse + 0.15*log(clip(evidence,1e-8,1))
reference: V32 fixed V17 uniform-pool sparse OOF; related fold uses identical sparse settings and fixed V17 external IDs with newly fitted training-only vocabulary
selection: All gates fixed before V30 results; no blend, temperature or epoch selection
submission_policy: Passing supports separate full-host training and full-ensemble inference validation; never directly submit a fold model
limitations: Repeatedly inspected development data, not an untouched confirmation set
Fold zero is reused pilot evidence
Related check is one predeclared related-prompt holdout, not full related-fold OOF
Sparse reference is not the complete public incumbent; no claim of beating 0.622 without an actual scored submission
Same external-only checkpoint across host folds is permissible only after verifying it saw no host labels
